Case B: A different product has an approved ANDA, and staff assume this permits substituting it for products with other routes and release formulations without a product-specific interchange assessment.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A BLA is the licensing application pathway for biological products, rather than a pharmacy's professional license.
The ANDA approval does not establish interchangeability across unrelated routes or release formulations.
Submitting an NDA establishes that the proposed drug is approved for marketing.
An IND-related research pathway is not the same as marketing approval for routine retail sale.

explanation.core_reasoning: 연구용 사용·운송 경로와 일반 판매승인을 분리한다. 제품 승인과 정확한 제형·route·strength·TE·주법상 대체조제 판단은 다르다. BLA·NDA·ANDA·IND가 답하는 규제 질문을 구별한다. 신청 접수·심사·승인 상태를 같은 것으로 처리하지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. BLA·NDA·ANDA·IND가 답하는 규제 질문을 구별한다.
choice_analysis.B: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 제품 승인과 정확한 제형·route·strength·TE·주법상 대체조제 판단은 다르다.
choice_analysis.C:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 신청 접수·심사·승인 상태를 같은 것으로 처리하지 않는다.

Case B: A pharmacist sees an emergency-use authorization and treats it as unrestricted full approval without checking the authorization's current conditions or covered population.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

An approved product's off-label use creates general independent prescribing authority for pharmacists.
Every OTC medicine is marketed through the monograph pathway and none through an approved application.
The identifier and listing do not by themselves establish FDA approval of the specific product.

choice_analysis.D: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. NDC·listing·DailyMed 검색과 실제 approval 증거를 구별한다.
